rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
rules.description: Externally influenced data changes the syntax or meaning of a command sent to a downstream command interpreter.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.

rules.cwe_name: Direct Request ('Forced Browsing')
rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.

rules.cwe_name: Permissions, Privileges, and Access Controls
rules.description: Legacy access-control category for failures in permissions, privileges, or authorization enforcement.

rules.cwe_name: Credentials Management Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for insecure credential creation, storage, validation, or handling.

rules.cwe_name: Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data
rules.description: Sensitive data is stored or transmitted without required encryption.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.

rules.cwe_name: Information Exposure Through Debug Log Files
rules.description: Sensitive information is written to debug or diagnostic log files.

rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
